title: RVCBench: Benchmarking the Robustness of Voice Cloning Across Modern Audio Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing voice cloning synthesis quality, speaker similarity, and word error rate across 12 different English accents (e.g., American, Indian, South African, Scottish) using the VCTK dataset.
Computing the performance gap in evaluation metrics (such as Speaker Similarity, Word Error Rate, and Mel-cepstral distortion) between male and female speakers.
Comparing model performance metrics across different target speaker age groups (under 20, 20-29, and 30 and over) to observe if age impacts cloning accuracy.
Testing multilingual and cross-lingual cloning performance using English, Mandarin, and French datasets to measure degradation when shifting away from predominantly English training data.
